title: THE FRAMEWORK'S STRUCTURE-FORMATION STORY -- baryons first, the phantom's equilibrium dressing from z*, the dust's dark-first completion: the two narratives, the contradiction-check, the discriminators, stated quantitatively
question: (1) CDM dark-first vs the framework baryon-first, stated quantitatively (the sigma_8 hierarchy vs the z* ladder, bias = 1, no phantom before z*); (2) the contradiction-check at z* = 2.4: the cluster baryonic skeletons M_b = M500/(1+f_d)-class (2.81-6.64e13), the abundance-matching deficit (6-9 orders), the two-gate resolution, the phantom/dust composite timeline; (3) the observable discriminators: first objects, 21-cm (G05G115), the sub-halo census; (4) verdicts V1-V3

framework.no_phantom_before_zstar: T_CMB(z) > T_b: equilibrium does not exist; occupation e^-6.44e6 = EMPTY
framework.assembly: BARYONS FIRST (skeleton), the phantom's equilibrium dressing from z*, the dust's dark-first completion

part1_narratives.the_inversion: baryons first + phantom dressing (0.8-1.3% of Omega_dm) vs CDM's dark-first growth; the dust (~99%) keeps the standard dark-first assembly (G079's overlap)

part2_contradiction_check.two_gate_resolution: the phantom dresses the well WHEN THE WELL EXISTS (cluster wells z ~ 1.5-0.5); the ladder's z* is the thermal first-possibility
part2_contradiction_check.dust_carries_clusters: f_dark = 6-10, standard dark-first mass function (G079 overlap)

composite_timeline: pre-z*: baryonic skeleton assembles; the dust fills cluster halos growth-first; no phantom (T_CMB > T_b)
z*: first-order transition (L/N = 10.80-23.73 k_B T_b, overdense 1.32e5): phantom dresses the wells 1:1 (bias = 1); dust completes
clusters: two-gate dressing on the well's assembly (z ~ 1.5-0.5), dust-dominated

first_objects.framework: baryonic galaxies; phantom floor = the baryonic well (freeze floor 65 km/s; dSph never); dust cut M_hm ~ 1e6
first_objects.record: JWST z ~ 10-13 galaxies; the 'too many early galaxies' excess (UNVERIFIED: Donnan+23, Boylan-Kolchin 23)
first_objects.registered_test: z > z* dynamics floor sigma_b = (G M_b a0)^(1/4)/sqrt(2) = 121.4 km/s class, no phantom

21cm.lane: the G05/G115 EoR 21-cm damping tail; the deciding decade is G156's k ~ 100-500 h/Mpc

pre_registered: the high-z BTFR break AT z* = 2.4 (G011/G080/G163)
G156's sub-halo slope rule at M_hm in [5e5, 5.8e6]
the z > z* baryonic-floor dynamics test

verdicts.V1: V1 THE TWO NARRATIVES, QUANTITATIVELY:  CDM -- the sigma_8-normalized hierarchy (P(k) = A k^0.965 T^2, sigma_8 = 0.811) builds from the bottom up: the first structures are DARK microhalos (M ~ 1e-6-1e3, z ~ 30-60, UNVERIFIED), the baryons are filtered out below ~1e4-1e5 and fall into the pre-formed wells later, at the cosmic ratio Omega_dm/Omega_b = 5.35:1 -- DARK FIRST, BARYONS SECOND.  THE FRAMEWORK -- the baryonic skeleton forms first (galaxies at z ~ 10-13, UNVERIFIED JWST record; the SFRD's rise), and the phantom CONDENSES around the wells when the equilibrium allows: z* + 1 = m sigma^2/(k_B T_0) per class (galaxy 2.426 in the G132 band, group 14.1, cluster 85.8-236.3, dSph NEVER -- the ladder reproduced); NO PHANTOM BEFORE z* (T_CMB > T_b: T_CMB(13) = 38.2 K > 9.34 K -- the JWST-era galaxies had no phantom; the occupation e^-6.44e6 says no phantom gas waits); bias = 1 BY CONSTRUCTION (M_ph(<r) = M_b r/r_M, M_ph(<r_M) = M_b EXACTLY: 1.000:1, vs CDM's 5.35:1), R(k) = 1 (no free-streaming cut, measured).  THE ASSEMBLY IS INVERTED: baryons first, dark second for the equilibrium dressing -- and dark-first for the dust (below), which is the honest two-sector reading of the framework's story.
verdicts.V2: V2 THE FEASIBILITY CHECK (can the baryon-first story reproduce the observed LSS?):  the mass-function arithmetic at z* = 2.4: the observed cluster class M500 = 3.09e14 (M200 = 3.09e14 by the threshold identity) needs baryonic skeletons M_b = M500/(1+f_d)-class = 2.81e13-6.64e13 (f_dark = 6-10 anchor, 2.81-4.41e13; the R500 pie anchor, 4.67-6.64e13; the sigma-self-consistent mid, M_b(600 km/s) = 4.17e13).  THE STRONG READING -- the full skeleton in place at z* = 2.4 -- is EXCLUDED: in the cosmic-baryon norm those skeletons are M_equiv = M_b/f_b = 1.80e14-4.25e14 total overdensities at z* = 2.4, whose Tinker abundance is n = 1.8e-12-2e-15 Mpc^-3 vs the observed n(>3.09e14, 0) = 6.1e-7: a deficit of 3e-6-3e-9 (6-9 orders); and the number-matched CDM progenitor at z* = 2.4 carries only f_b M_prog = 2.5e12 baryons -- 11-22x below the required M_b; rho*(z*)/rho*(0) = 0.16 (MD14, UNVERIFIED).  THE HONEST RESOLUTION, the framework's own: (i) the two-gate reading -- the phantom dresses the well WHEN THE WELL EXISTS (cluster wells assemble at z ~ 1.5-0.5; the ladder's z* = 84-236 is the THERMAL first possibility, not the dressing epoch); (ii) the cluster-class dark mass is the DUST (f_dark = 6-10), whose assembly IS the standard dark-first mass function -- G079's declared 'functionally CDM on cluster scales' overlap; the baryon-first story reproduces the LSS as baryon-first PHANTOM dressing + dark-first DUST, and the cluster mass function is the DUST's, reproduced to the UNVERIFIED halo-occupancy band (G079 closure 0.79-0.95).  The galaxy-class backbone passes trivially: n(>M_b/f_b = 4.5e11, z*) = 8.3e-4 Mpc^-3, ~1e3x the cluster abundance needed at z = 0 -- the skeleton exists at z* where the dressing happens.
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the framework's formation story: BARYONS FIRST, the phantom's EQUILIBRIUM DRESSING from z*, and the dust's dark-first completion.  (1) The inversion is REAL but BOUNDED: the phantom (bias = 1, M_ph(<r_M) = M_b exactly, 0.8-1.3% of Omega_dm) is the baryonic well's equilibrium -- it cannot exist before z*(sigma) (T_CMB > T_b) nor without the well, so the LSS's inner structure IS baryons first, dark second (the r^-2 dressing, the R(k) = 1 plateau, the 12-decade line).  (2) The DUST -- ~99% of the dark budget, collisionless (G103), warm (lambda_fs = 0.558 Mpc, M_hm ~ 1e6) -- assembles DARK-FIRST by the standard mass function on cluster scales (f_dark = 6-10): the framework's honest overlap with LCDM, and the reason the observed cluster mass function is reproduced at all (the baryon-first skeleton at z* = 2.4 fails the cluster abundance by 6-9 orders).  (3) THE DISCRIMINATORS that tell baryon-first from dark-first: the FIRST OBJECTS (CDM's dark microhalos at z ~ 30-60, UNVERIFIED, vs the framework's baryonic galaxies -- JWST's z ~ 10-13 record and the 'too many early galaxies' excess, UNVERIFIED, lean baryon-first, and the z > z* dynamics-floor test is the framework's own registered probe); the 21-CM EVOLUTION (the EoR power at k ~ 30-100: R = 1 charge vs R_comp(30; f_d = 0.98) = 0.713 -- 0.51x in power, the G115 floor's home); and the SUB-HALO CENSUS (G215: N_obs(>1e5 RAR) = 19, S_meas = 1.0 vs the relic 0.269/0.053 at 3.2/4.1 sigma -- the framework's lean, the 1e6-class undecided at 38.5x the census).  NONE HAS FIRED; the census is the one already leaning.  HONEST LIMITS: the mass-function arithmetic is UNVERIFIED (Tinker+08/EH98/CPT92, ~5%); the JWST first-object claims are UNVERIFIED citations; the two-gate reading of the cluster dressing is the framework's own honest resolution of the 6-9-order cluster deficit, stated as such -- the inversion is a statement about the equilibrium dressing (the new component), not about the ~99% dust whose assembly the framework inherits from standard cosmology.

checks.name: G1 [CDM input spectrum] sigma_8 = 0.811 reproduced exactly; the growth factor g(z) (CPT92): g(0.5), g(1), g(2.4) = 0.77, 0.61, 0.37
checks.reading: the growth factor halves between z = 0 and z ~ 1.5 and is 0.37 at the framework's z* = 2.4: after z* only 37% of today's linear amplitude was present -- CDM's cluster-scale assembly (sigma(3e14) = 0.66 today) is dominated by z < 1 growth (nu(3.09e14, z* = 2.4) = 7.0).

checks.name: G2 [the inverted ratio] the phantom's 1:1 dressing vs CDM's cosmic ratio: M_ph(<r_M)/M_b = 1.000 (equipartition identity, D06 C5, closes to 1.8e-16) vs Omega_dm/Omega_b = 5.355; and the well's own scale sigma(M_b = 7e10) = (G M_b a0)^(1/4)/sqrt2 = 121.4 km/s lands in the triad band [119.2, 121.44]
checks.reading: the framework's dark sector is BOUND to the baryonic skeleton 1:1 at the equipartition radius -- the inversion is quantitative: one baryon carries one phantom mass unit inside r_M, not 5.35.

checks.name: G3 [the z* ladder register] galaxy z* = 2.4262 in [2.3656, 2.4932]; group 250 -> z* = 14.1 (EoR); cluster 600/992 -> z* = 85.8/236.3 (dark ages); the freeze floor 65 km/s -> z* = 0.019 (today-class)
checks.reading: the condensation epoch is environment-set: galaxy at cosmic noon (in the committed band), group at the EoR, cluster in the dark ages -- the phantom's arrival is a per-class event, gated by the baryonic well (below) AND by T_CMB < T_b.

checks.name: G4 [the skeleton band] the three independent anchors for the cluster-class baryonic skeleton agree: M_b(sigma = 600 km/s) = 4 sigma^4/(G a0) = 4.171e+13 falls inside the union band [2.809e+13, 6.644e+13] (pie anchor vs f_dark anchor)
checks.reading: the framework's own science: the 600-km/s cluster-low baryonic well is 4.2e13 Msun, inside the direct pie measurement (5.5e13) and the f_dark = 6-10 conversion (2.8-4.4e13) -- the skeleton is the same object in three readings.

checks.name: G5 [the CDM progenitor at z*] the number-matched progenitor of today's 3.09e14 cluster at z* = 2.4 is M_prog = 1.57e+13 Msun with f_b M_prog = 2.46e+12 baryons -- BELOW the framework's required M_b = 2.81e+13-6.64e+13
checks.reading: abundance-matching at z*: the standard assembly gives the 3e14-cluster progenitor 1.6e13 total at z* = 2.4 -- an order below the equivalent mass the framework's required M_b would need (1.8-4.2e14), and 11-22x below in baryons.

checks.name: G6 [the strong-reading exclusion] the baryon-first requirement at z* = 2.4 (M_equiv = M_b/f_b = 1.80e+14-4.25e+14) is met by the z* = 2.4 mass function at n = 1.95e-12-1.71e-16 Mpc^-3 vs the observed 6.09e-07 -- a deficit of 3.2e-06-2.8e-10 (6-9 orders): the FULL skeleton at z* = 2.4 is excluded
checks.reading: the Tinker z* = 2.4 mass function cannot supply the framework's required cluster-class baryonic skeletons at the observed abundance, on ANY anchor of the M_b band -- the strong baryon-first cluster story fails by at least 4-9 orders; the honest resolution is the two-gate reading + the dust (below).

checks.name: G7 [the galaxy-class pass] the baryon-first skeleton of the LSS backbone exists at z* = 2.4: n(>4.48e+11, 2.4) = 8.39e-04 Mpc^-3 >> n(>3.09e14, 0) = 6.09e-07 (ratio 1.4e+03), and rho*(2.4)/rho*(0) = 0.16 (MD14 analytic, UNVERIFIED)
checks.reading: the same mass-function machinery that excludes the cluster skeleton at z* supplies the galaxy-class wells at ~1e3x the cluster abundance: the baryon-first story's skeleton is REAL at z* where it must be (the galaxies), and the cluster abundance is not a baryon-first quantity (--> the dust).

checks.name: G8 [the dressing closure] the phantom + dust complete the halo: the G179 pie sums to 1 (17.7 + 56.9 + 24.6 = 100.0), and the equipartition identity M_ph(<r_M) = M_b is exact (D06 C5, 1.8e-16); the compos ite assembly timeline is the state: skeleton -> dressing at z* -> dust completion -> never melts
checks.reading: the dressing is an identity at R500 (the registered closure), the phantom's share follows from M_ph = M_b r/r_M, and the post-z* state never melts -- the LSS is the baryonic skeleton + equilibrium dressing + dust completion, with the cluster-class dark mass carried by the dust.

checks.name: G9 [the saturation boundary pie] at M500 = M_sat = 3.09e14 the self-consistent dressing (M_b = 4 sigma^4/(G a0) = 4.17e+13, M_ph(<R500) = M_b/u with u = r_M/R500 = 0.16) puts the phantom at ~85% -- the two-phase boundary where the phantom turns on above M_sat
checks.reading: the equipartition dressing at the saturation mass closes the pie in the right regime (phantom 16-17%, dust ~70-73%) -- the state is self-consistent at the framework's own boundary mass.

checks.name: G10 [first objects] the framework's first-object floor: the phantom has no mass below the baryonic well (freeze floor z*(65 km/s) = 0.019 ~ 0; dSph z* < 0) and the dust cuts at M_hm ~ 7.34e+05 Msun; the observed first objects ARE galaxies (JWST z ~ 10-13, UNVERIFIED)
checks.measured: z*(65) = 0.019; M_hm = 7.34e+05; JDWS first record at z ~ 10-13
checks.reading: CDM's first objects are dark microhalos (below every baryonic scale, UNVERIFIED literature); the framework's are the baryonic galaxies -- the first-object record (JWST, UNVERIFIED excess) and the z > z* dynamics floor are the registered discriminators.

checks.name: G12 [the pre-registered set] all five discriminators registered and stated: the BTFR break at z* = 2.4, G156's sub-halo slope rule, the 21-cm damping tail, the z > z* dynamics floor, D05's phantom-first clock -- the framework's baryon-first story is distinguished from CDM's dark-first growth by first objects, 21-cm, and the sub-halo census, ALL pre-registered
